extracted_summary: """Load scaling — turning a concentration index into a dropoff multiplier. The dropoff table applies a flat factor per position group. That is wrong when a team funnels everything through one man. This converts a Herfindahl index into an effective-count and scales the factor by how far the team sits from league normal. HHI is unitless and unintuitive; 1/HHI is the effective number of contributors, which is the same quantity in interpretable units (the "effective number of competitors" transform, Davies 2025).
